rv.q: Even if you've caught the play before, this impeccable production is a must-see.
Audible and TOGETHER should be commended for mounting this first-class revival of a play that shouldn’t be as obscure as it is.

cn.t: Tom Noonan's intense two-character first date play receives an excellent revival, with critics praising its darkly hilarious and wrenching exploration of human connection that remains potent three decades after it was written.
